provenance_statement: All 20 tasks in this benchmark are independently specified evaluation tasks with explicit synthetic oracles, designed to rigorously test single-function repair, class-method repair, coordinated multi-file patching, and negative safety containment. They are not harvested from real-world GitHub repositories, ensuring exact reproducibility and eliminating hidden dependencies.
